name: Almonacid de la Sierra (Spain)
description: A red triangle at the hoist bearing a white crescent, the fly with diagonal stripes of white and blue.
history: Municipal flag of Almonacid de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: large triangle with its base at the hoist
diagonal stripes of white and blue from the lower fly to the upper hoist
